steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we have arrived at our terminus—
Lake Silberneherze Station.
Located in the center of a basin, clear and scenic Lake Silberneherze is one of the gems of Kjerag.
Legends say that it is the first tear shed by Kjeragandr. In winter, one can walk on the frozen surface and see into the depths of the lake.
The newly-built statue of Kjeragandr stands on an island in the middle of the lake, watching over Kjerag and her people.
Ladies and gentlemen, we have arrived...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: So... it's all a misunderstanding?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No secrets, no assassinations, no VIP on the train, no nothing?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If there's any VIP that got me on this train, it was you.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Viscount Harold Craigavon, the renowned burdenbeast veterinarian who has become a household name amongst the pastoralists.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'm honored.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I beg your pardon, Madam Degenbrecher.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It was hard not to make certain inferences from the blood on your gloves.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Blood?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Should I explain?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I guess I could tell you, if you really want to know.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I do. Please.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Lily's birthing wasn't easy.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It was premature. She bled a lot, and I had my hands full.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Premature...? She bled?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: That's no laughing matter. How is my girl?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I performed first aid, but she needs a professional follow-up.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Leones says he trusts you the most, Craigavon.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's up to you now.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I'll be there in two shakes of a beast's tail!

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You look disappointed. Were you expecting something else?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Fine enough by me. I could live up to those expectations.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: There's no need for that.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So, what's the misunderstanding?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ah, well... Lake Silberneherze is a nice place, isn't it?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Particularly on a sunny, clear day like this, when even the air smells particularly fresh...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Do Victorians always talk about the weather when they're trying to change the subject?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I must have heard this a few thousand times by now.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Forgive me. We learn from a young age to use Victoria's awful weather as a conversation starter.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Kindly refrain from besmirching the good name of Victoria, My Lord.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why are you guys still standing around chatting?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is our little misunderstanding all cleared up now?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Of course, of course.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Nothing would have happened, if not for some alarmists amongst us.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whatever, as long as it's all cleared up now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Running up and down a train was fun, but I've had enough of eating dust under a table.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I went ahead and had a look. A tour guide gave me two maps!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Lake Silberneherze is just down the street from here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Should we go now?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well... dreadfully sorry, Rosalind, but I'm afraid I won't be able to keep my promise.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: There's a lady who needs me at her side, right now.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Lily is a burdenbeast, right? Not some Victorian noble codeword?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Perish the thought!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Fine, fine. Go see to your 'Lily'. I can take care of myself here.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Rosalind...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wh-What's that look on your face?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You're such a kind, thoughtful girl!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Come, let's exchange contact information.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: You must find me, should you ever need anything. I am ever at your service.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: And I'll keep an eye out for your father... handsome Kjerag fellow, you said?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Thanks for that, dedushka.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, you guys get back to your chat, I'm gonna get going.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Such a lovely young lady, so strong and cheerful even after losing her mother...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...A handsome Kjerag fellow?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh, you heard?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Rosalind came to Kjerag to find her long-lost father.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It's a touching story. I hope her efforts bear fruit.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Her father...?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is that what she said?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Well, now that our misunderstanding has been resolved...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Madam Degenbrecher, I'm a huge fan of your work. Could I perhaps beg your autogr—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I'm leaving. Take care of Lily.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Wait, Madam Degenbrecher!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Ach—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: She's gone.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Black Knight does not seem to take much pride in glories past.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Small wonder, considering the manner in which she was exiled from Kazimierz...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Oh, I'm sorry, I forgot you were still here.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I didn't want to inadvertently offend the Black Knight.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Glad to know you're so self-aware.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It was my mistake. I should have been more careful with my words.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But do you really believe Madam Degenbrecher's reasoning?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Black Knight has ever been Silverash's loyal lieutenant, from the moment she left Kazimierz and followed him to Kjerag.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: She has been in the mountains lately, training a new unit of troops for Karlan Trade.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We also have reports of unusual goods moving in and out of Kjerag, involving materials of a sensitive nature.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Your point...?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: All conjecture at this time.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But you have your suspicions too, don't you? That's why you kept the young Rosalind's contact.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Looks like your time in Victoria has instilled in you a pathological mistrust of others. What a shame.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That is my profession, after all.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I will report today's events to the Duke, exactly as they happened.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Wait...!

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Allow me to remind you once more, My Lord.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You have a duty you are obligated to carry out. Do not fail Her Grace.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is not a sightseeing trip.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Have you given Karlan Trade's proposal some thought, Mr. Taylor?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand Matterhorn has taken you to see our mines and factories. Are you satisfied with what you've seen from Kjerag and Karlan Trade?

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: I have no complaints about your company, Mr. Silverash.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: But you're a businessman too. I'm sure you understand.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: I would have few reasons to harbor any doubts, if it was Karlan Trade I was dealing with.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: But if I'm to deal with the government of Kjerag, which we know little about... I do feel that more due diligence is in order when it comes to a project of this size.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: I saw Victorian soldiers on the streets a few days ago.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: There's no conflict brewing between Kjerag and Victoria... is there?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I assure you that no harm will come to you in Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Take your time, Mr. Taylor. Kjerag won't disappoint you.

steps.name: Columbian Magnate
steps.text: Excellent! I look forward to a fruitful partnership, Mr. Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You will continue to serve as Mr. Taylor's guide tomorrow, Matterhorn.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Attend to any need he has, within reason.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: But... are we really going to work with him?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You don't think he'd be a good partner?

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: It's not my place to judge.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: However, he has found various excuses to put off signing the contract while here in Kjerag, and went back on his word more than once on profit sharing. I fear...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Indeed, he is a shrewd merchant.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag has no choice but to work with shrewd merchants at present, while these same shrewd merchants have their pick of options.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My job is to make Kjerag their only choice.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Go and check on Degenbrecher's recruits.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Have them escort Mr. Taylor.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enciodes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Look at that, you're using a communicator. I thought you didn't like these long-range methods.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I just don't like to be contacted.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: There's something you should know, Enciodes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I ran into a girl from Rhodes Island on the train to Lake Silberneherze.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Did you enter into a new partnership with them?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Kjerag snow cheese, burdenbeast accessories, Saintess portraits!

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: All Kjerag specialties, get them here!

steps.name: Competing Vendor
steps.text: Burdenbeast blind boxes! Limited edition! While supplies last!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's so lively here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What are they selling?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Portraits of the Saintess? That's not what Pramanix looks like...

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Now, now, girly, the Saintess personally approved this portrait! It's the real deal!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Right, whatever you say.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll have some snow cheese, then. Is that the most popular treat?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I might've had some when I was little.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: You're a local?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You could say that.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Should've said so. Don't buy the snow cheese.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: That's for tourists. We don't buy that stuff.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: This shaved cheese is much cheaper and tastes pretty much the same.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wait, aren't you just ripping off tourists then?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Hey, don't put it like that!

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Look at the packaging on this snow cheese. See how nice it is? That's what the tourists want. Something nice and classy-looking.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: All I'm doing is making a few francs off the packaging. It's not like I'm selling inferior stuff. The cheese itself is first-rate!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I guess you have a point.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll have the shaved cheese, then. Can I ask you something else, too?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is there a man in Kjerag that everyone agrees is the handsomest?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: The handsomest man, huh?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Well... I'm a Paleroche, but I'm not gonna lie.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has got to be the handsomest fellow in Kjerag.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Enciodes... Wait, SilverAsh?!

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Yeah, the patriarch of Clan Silverash.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: No, no way... it can't be...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How about another guy? Anybody else?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Er, well... um...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Never mind, just a random thought. Forget I asked.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How about something else...? That mountain by the shore of Lake Silberneherze?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Does it have a name or something?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Oh, that's Mount Fugen!

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: It's famous for its romantic atmosphere. Lots of young couples go there.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Young couples...?

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: They say any couple that watches the sunrise there will stay together forever. What's that old saying again? 'Kjerag's love is like the unmelting ice.' Humbug, if you ask me.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: But lots of tourists go there. They hang the golden lock of love or something... oh, now that I think of it.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Sir Arctosz likes to go there to hunt, and he's none too happy about all the tourists who get in his way.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright. Here's the money for the cheese.

steps.name: Local Vendor
steps.text: Thank you. Come again!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So this is the Lake Silberneherze that Mamochka always talked about...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And that's Mount Fugen.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Not a bad view, but Ursus has icy lakes just like it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, the ice goes pretty deep.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Is that the statue of Kjeragandr? Can't see the face.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wow, it's big alright. Wonder how much stone they used to build it.
Stone?
Our Kjeragandr statue wouldn't settle for stone!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Gotta hand it to you: You've got good taste. This is the best spot to admire Kjeragandr's statue.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Er... who might you be?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: A-Ahem! That's not important. What's important is what you just said!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Kjeragandr's statue isn't made from any old stone. We used the finest materials to express our love for Her!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: The finest, huh?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Like, what?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Like I said, the finest—

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: —Ow!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What? Did you bite your tongue!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: It's a secret, of course! Can't just go around blabbering to tourists.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I can't tell you the details, but anyway... just know that it's really amazing!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You almost let it slip.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Just almost.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Fine, fine, you didn't say anything.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, enjoy the view. I gotta get going.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Oh, hey, wait up!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What is it this time?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, you're a tourist, right?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Kjeragandr's statue's getting officially unveiled right here the day after tomorrow, in the morning.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: If you're still in Kjerag, you won't wanna miss it!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Now you're just talking to yourself.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who knows what's gonna happen in two days? Makes no difference looking at it today.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Of course it makes a difference!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: The Saintess is officiating the ceremony herself! You might even get to see Kjeragandr in spirit!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: You... say, what's your name?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Rosalind.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Full name.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ty nevynosima...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Ursine) Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Alright, Rosalind, I'll make this official!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I, Sciurus Browntail, formally invite Rosalind Tatyanovna Larina to attend the unveiling ceremony for Kjeragandr's statue that takes place in two day's time!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Then you'll know that this Kjeragandr is special. There's no other like Her.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You sure are confident.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well, I guess I'll look forward to it.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Wait, I haven't given you the invitation letter yet!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Why are you in such a hurry, anyway?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Sciurus, younger sister of the Browntail Matriarch. Frequently visits other countries on behalf of Kjerag, in recent years.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Did she arrange for Rosalind to be here?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I should find a way to eavesdrop...

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Sir, you've been standing in front of my stall holding that newspaper of yours for five minutes.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: I need you to buy something, or move out of the way.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Oh, pardon me. One burdenbeast milk tea au lait, please.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Alright, I guess that takes care of that bitch Ratatos's job.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Makes no sense... why do I have to keep an eye on a some kid? Even talk to her, no less?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Gotta say, though, the girl looks slightly familiar...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Rus?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Are you sure you don't need my help?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Leave it to me. I got this.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Let's go. I want Ratatos to tell me what the deal is with that Rosalind girl!
